sections.title: 3. Evaluation: From Components to Integrated AI4AI
4. Model Design: From Policy Improvement to Weight-Layer AI4AI
5. Harness Design: Runtime Functions Outside the Weights
6. Open Problems: Four Scales of Failure

framework_axes.summary: D1 target; D2 self-reference; D3 stage ownership; D4 signal grounding; D5 measured gain/retention/human comparison/held-out transfer.
Separate pressure, closure, evidence. Six pressure coordinates: human-effort time, interaction length, context/memory, grounding, planning dependency, verification observability.

what_mutates.summary: Data/tasks, weights, computational substrate, harness, evaluators, research processes. Improving a different AI artifact is AI4AI but need not be self-improvement.

feedback.summary: Grounding strength and observability are separate: formal/executable checks, holdouts, learned rewards, model judges, introspection; no source is universally complete.

ownership.summary: Goal/plan/execute/feedback/repair coded HUM/MIX/SYS per version and protocol. Under strict design-time coding, all 35 sampled goals are human-owned and no feedback stage is fully system-owned.

recursion.summary: Self-reference, editable successor-producing process, runtime closure and boundedness are separate properties; recursive structure need not imply full autonomous control.

evaluation.summary: G/R/H/T are independent fields. Retention can include further within-pass/round improvement and is not a universal no-forgetting test. Component versus integrated benchmarks, repeated-run consistency, matched budgets, model–harness attribution and held-out transfer.

limits.summary: Composition gap; weak causal judgment, independent research direction and compounding evidence. Audit sample is purposive, capped search incomplete, no two completed human annotations.
Corpus systematic freeze 2026-08-04, targeted verification through 2026-08-13; publication date does not extend the review window.

negative_evidence.summary: RSIBench-Data: 58.33% of settings improve versus first valid attempt; among searches continuing beyond their best checkpoint, 78.26% finish below that peak. Different denominators.
Harness-evolution advantages over inference scaling are not consistent under matched feedback and inference budgets; held-out transfer limited.

sections.title: 6. Repair and Optimization of Existing Systems

framework_axes.summary: Two overlapping engineering goals: infrastructure design; repair/optimization of existing systems. Six target sectors: weights, tasks, memory, programs, feedback, improver.
Functional retained solver S and improver I; task gain, retention/transfer, improver gain require different probes.

what_mutates.summary: Data and parameters, memories and skills, prompts/programs/harnesses, judges, update processes or recursive context; functional roles can share implementation.

feedback.summary: Answers, execution, environmental outcomes, model judgments and human input differentiated by use in generation, training and selection; new external information is part of the mechanism.

ownership.summary: Editable scope and externally fixed anchors recorded at configuration level; no universal capability ladder or method maturity ranking.

recursion.summary: Structural return path is distinct from useful improver improvement. Metan uses a fixed operator with evolving recursive context; deeper calls do not establish changing the operator or increasing gains.

evaluation.summary: Sealed audit after all runs; full-budget frozen-improver/no-update controls; paired held-out starting solver probes; archive-best/deployed/final distinctions.

limits.summary: Narrative review, not exhaustive systematic review or meta-analysis. Bibliographic/abstract screening differs from full-text protocol coding. Main discovery cutoff Sep 12, historical supplement Sep 20.
Figures encode thematic routes, not ancestry. Survey comparison table partly based on selected passages and two abstract-only surveys.

negative_evidence.summary: STOP weaker-model configurations regress; Hyperagents transfer changes starting task-agent state and formatting; some source-domain differences not statistically significant.
Metan archive-best can exceed best single chain; partial budget parity and mixed split/unsplit evidence do not establish global advantage.

sections.title: 5. System Security, Resilience, Privacy, and Data Governance
A. Literature Coverage and Citation Scope

framework_axes.summary: Functional policy h, inductive bias B, bias-update function U; diagnosis/proposal/evaluation/implementation S1–S4 and recursive application to U (RI).
Four themes under Improvement Validity, Constraint Preservation, Effective Oversight; update/successor/meta-improvement claim levels; eight requirement groups.

what_mutates.summary: Policy weights/prompts/memory/skills; bias governing data selection, objectives or learning; updater governing revisions of bias. A shared module can have multiple roles.

feedback.summary: Experience E and performance/improvement feedback F; independent reporting separated from acceptance feedback reused for improvement.

ownership.summary: Human approval may remain. Changed goals/requirements require authorization; candidate cannot be sole approval authority over safeguards or control roots.

recursion.summary: Strict RSI revises and reuses U, not merely policy h or learned bias B. Promptbreeder illustrates changing B under fixed U in this functional boundary.

evaluation.summary: Paired fixed-updater continuations from equal h/B/persistent state; same reporting tests and continuation budget; discovery/validation cost separately included in total-cost efficiency; joint criteria must hold on aligned trajectories.

limits.summary: Direct RI, general persistent evolution and related fixed-system risk evidence are distinct. Study-level coverage is not joint evidence from the same trajectory.
Search through Oct 26; 301 works and 260 evidence cells are stated corpus counts, not field prevalence.

negative_evidence.summary: Self-authored tests can remain favorable while protected deployment performance worsens; grader drift or shared errors can inflate gains.
Poisoned Hyperagents benchmark leads to inherited insecure task instructions; clean further evolution does not necessarily remove them. Demonstrated target edits do not isolate U revision.

sections.title: 2 Foundations of Recursive Self-Improving AI and Evolutionary Safety

framework_axes.summary: Persistence, mutable scope, loop closure are independent; variation/selection/inheritance motivate evolutionary risk.
Five domains: persistent agent state; model state; evaluation/environmental feedback; computational substrate; meta-level updates/co-evolution.
Six manifestations: intent drift, error accumulation/amplification, experience contamination, safety erosion, evaluator drift/selection distortion, risk inheritance/propagation.

what_mutates.summary: Agent artifacts, learned parameters, execution substrate, evaluator/updater and reciprocal learning conditions. Reciprocal adaptation need not modify individual update rules.

feedback.summary: Environmental experience and candidate selection feedback distinguished; frozen references and overlapping evaluator versions preserve comparability.

ownership.summary: Modifications, verification and authorization must have enforceable boundaries; proposing a change is not authority to approve it.

recursion.summary: Persistent system adaptation need not revise the update procedure. Updater revision and reciprocal adaptation are different meta-level mechanisms.

evaluation.summary: State/update/trajectory/lineage units; exposure-aware risk, source removal, repaired-state continuation, frozen-channel causal comparisons, candidate selection risk shift.

limits.summary: Shared descendant failures alone do not demonstrate transmission; provenance gives possible routes, interventions/descendant tests stronger evidence. Newly discovered failure need not be newly caused.
Governance and composition guarantees remain conditional; restoration of software state does not undo physical effects.

negative_evidence.summary: Capability can improve while safety erodes; evaluator drift can mimic improvement. Risk accumulation must distinguish extra exposure from per-opportunity degradation.

papers.title: Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey
papers.latest_version_check: Official abstract and PDF margin say v1, 8 Sep 2026; PDF body separately says Date: October 2, 2026. Unresolved inconsistency; identifier month is not used to overwrite either date.

framework_axes.summary: SAVER pairs Substrate × Adaptation then traces Violation, Exposure, Response; ordering is analytical, not mandatory chronology or required delay before prevention.
Seven operations: add, abstract, activate, modify, forget, propagate, migrate; selection before commitment and response feedback beyond the transition.

what_mutates.summary: Reusable memory/context, skills/tools, workflow/routing, shared artifacts and agent-loop model-side state. Same content can change authority, scope and persistence when moved between carriers.

feedback.summary: Utility is distinct from authorization. Legitimate local experience can lose source/use constraints during abstraction; adversarial and endogenous drift tracks should be separate.

ownership.summary: Storage permission is not activation authority; grants depend on current user/task/effect/context. Governance state also needs protected lineage and renewed authorization.

recursion.summary: Scope broader than strict RSI: reusable influence evolving inside the agent loop matters even if updater fixed; context accumulation without persistent update is a different mechanism.

evaluation.summary: Stage-specific opportunity sets; containment != repair. Seed/adapt/delay/trigger/expose/repair/probe/continue contract; descendants and resumed adaptation define spatial/temporal scope of recovery.

limits.summary: Frozen coding pool 683 papers, 549 low-confidence placements; scoping survey not preregistered, no independent dual screening. Counts not prevalence and corpus freeze Sep 4 distinct from later prose evidence.
Missing triggers do not establish safe retained state; connected trace or merged coverage table does not establish joint repair or permanent protection.

negative_evidence.summary: SkillMisevo/SafeEvolve: online benign utility 58.44→58.00%, carryover utility 53.33→40.67%; immediate utility cost differs from reuse cost.
PASB 45.0 vs 71.9% observed downstream failure groups are not randomized memory-disabled controls; group contrast not causal effect of memory.

cross_survey_findings.claim: Targets, ownership, retained state, recursive dependency, effect and evaluation must be reported separately.
Functional mappings are not identical: Promptbreeder may count as mutable improver machinery in C, whereas T places mutation prompts in B under fixed U.
Historical routes are thematic mechanism families, not demonstrated technical ancestry; first-public and revision dates must be separated.
Independent and longitudinal assessment must jointly align capability, constraint preservation and effective intervention on the same trajectory.
Retention, source removal, containment, descendant repair and post-repair continued adaptation are distinct evidence burdens.
